ns2:course.label: Intermediate Swahili I
ns2:course.description: Second-year Swahili with emphasis on developing conversational fluency; some readings on Swahili culture and customs. Participation in the language laboratory may be required. Same as AFST 433. Summer 2008: 5 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Fall 2008: 4 hours only. Prerequisite: One year of Swahili.
